title: State loneliness is associated with emotional hypervigilance in daily life: A network analysis
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-subject network
visualisation_packages: qgraph (not explicitly named, but Fruchterman-Reingold algorithm used for visualization)
limitations: - Participants not screened for neurological or psychiatric disorders; - Limited number of variables used; - No measurement of social interactions and contexts; - Stationary assumption for multi-level VAR modeling may not hold; - Observational data limits causal interpretation
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. Code and data availability are not explicitly stated in the main text, but supplementary materials may contain them. The authors used the mlVAR package in R for network estimation, and visualization was done using the Fruchterman-Reingold algorithm.
